title: Plants
status: draft: written 19 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 1 Environmental Activities; not yet checked by a CBC Environmental Activities teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child names and points to the parts of a plant: roots, stem, leaves, flowers.
representations: a real small plant with roots
steps: Point to each part and name it.
Pull up a weed to see roots.
contexts: a mango tree in the compound

board.do: Draw a plant with roots under a soil line.
Wait for the child to say the roots.

misconceptions.repair: Gently pull up a weed. Show the roots.

misconceptions.ask: What is the part that holds up the leaves called?
misconceptions.repair: Use a pulled-up plant: green stem above, roots below.

misconceptions.ask: Grass has no flowers today. Is grass a plant?
misconceptions.repair: Walk and find plants with and without flowers.

misconceptions.ask: Is a mango tree a plant?
misconceptions.repair: Compare a bean plant and a tree: both have roots, stem, leaves.

checks.question: Which part of a plant is under the soil?
Name the part that holds up the leaves.
